crossRefs.note: and houses full of all good things which you didn’t fill, and cisterns dug out which you didn’t dig, vineyards and…
then beware lest you forget Yahweh, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
Praise Yahweh, my soul, and don’t forget all his benefits,
He commanded the multitudes to sit down on the grass; and he took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up to…
However boats from Tiberias came near to the place where they ate the bread after the Lord had given thanks.
He who observes the day, observes it to the Lord; and he who does not observe the day, to the Lord he does not observe…
Whether therefore you eat, or drink, or whatever you do, do all to the glory of God.
In everything give thanks, for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus toward you.
For every creature of God is good, and nothing is to be rejected, if it is received with thanksgiving.
For it is sanctified through the word of God and prayer.
But who am I, and what is my people, that we should be able to offer so willingly as this? For all things come from…
Praise Yahweh, my soul, and don’t forget all his benefits,
Honor Yahweh with your substance, with the first fruits of all your increase:

translations.web: You shall eat and be full, and you shall bless Yahweh your God for the good land which he has given you.
translations.bsb: When you eat and are satisfied, you are to bless the LORD your God for the good land that He has given you.
translations.kjv: When thou hast eaten and art full, then thou shalt bless the LORD thy God for the good land which he hath given
translations.asv: And thou shalt eat and be full, and thou shalt bless Jehovah thy God for the good land which he hath given thee.
